no_project: Open a project to see what happened in it.
activity_about: What happened in the project's documents: the comments people left and the checks the detectors ran. Only the latest are kept — a detector's verdict is one record per detector per document, so running one again replaces its answer rather than adding to it. A run of the same check one after another is one row; open it for its documents.
empty_body: Run a check on the Specs tab, or sync a repository to pull its comments.
activity_failed: The activity could not be read: {error}
timeline_about: The project's milestones. They are milestone objects of the Studio domain model, so their fields are whatever the model gives them.
no_milestones: No milestones yet. Add the first one: a name and a date are enough.
no_milestone_type: This organization's domain model has no milestone type — milestones come with the Project lifecycle kit — so there is nothing to show.
milestone_type_dormant: Milestones are not in use here: the Project lifecycle kit that brings them has left them dormant. They are kept, and show again once the kit is installed again.
model_failed: The domain model could not be read: {error}
milestones_failed: The milestones could not be read: {error}
milestones_incomplete: Only the first {count} milestones are shown.
delete_note: The milestone goes from the project's Timeline.
